comments.author: @ParadoxTravel
comments.text: A 150 sqm house for $500 and $15 doctor visits, yet a sudden stroke means a 3-hour highway dash to Manila and an upfront cash deposit. Honestly, in your 70s, would you choose affordable financial freedom and human warmth here, or stay broke near a top US trauma center?

comments.author: @travellives
comments.text: Calling this 'living like royalty' is a stretch. Dealing with blackouts, typhoons, and 35-degree heat in your 70s sounds exhausting, not relaxing
